title: Geek Bar Pulse Miami Mint Vape 15000 Puffs
description:
Flavored 15000 Puffs with Geek Bar Pulse Miami Mint Vape
With its flawless integration of taste and innovation, the Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape establishes a new benchmark for disposable vaping devices. With its two power modes, the normal mode maximizes taste consistency while preserving battery life by guaranteeing up to 15,000 puffs using an alternatively heated mesh coil. An alternative is the pulse mode, which increases the output and airflow to 20W and produces denser vapor with a complete taste experience lasting up to 7,500 puffs.
Enhanced Nicotine Content
Every pull from this disposable vaporizer delivers a strong yet pleasant dose since its nicotine content is kept at 5%. The 16ml e-liquid capacity that comes preloaded guarantees a substantial supply before refill is required. Long-term usage is supported by the 650mAh built-in battery, which is conveniently recharged via the USB Type-C connector. The
Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse
15000 blends simplicity and performance with its draw-activated mechanism and integrated twin mesh coil, offering vapers a cool, minty getaway.
Review of Miami Mint Flavor
The right amount of minty coolness creates a sense that is both invigorating and calming. The flavor profile is defined by a smooth inhale that leaves your palate feeling lightly coated with mint aromas, and a pleasant exhale that leaves your taste receptors feeling slightly sweetened.
Additional Features:
5% (50mg) Nicotine
Rechargeable 650mAh Battery
Approximately 15000 Puffs
Type-C Port (Not Included)
Dual Mesh coil
Draw-Activated
20W output
FAQ
What makes the Miami Mint flavor unique?
The Miami Mint flavor offers a smooth, minty inhale with a slightly sweet exhale, providing a refreshing and cooling sensation.
How does the pulse mode work on the Geek Bar Pulse Miami Mint?
Pulse mode increases the output and airflow to 20W, creating denser vapor and a fuller taste experience.
Is the Geek Bar Pulse Miami Mint suitable for beginners?
Yes, it’s simple, draw-activated design and refreshing flavor make it suitable for both beginners and experienced vapers.
What is the Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It is a disposable vape offering up to 15000 puffs with a refreshing mint flavor and innovative dual power modes.
